{"description":"Read the git history of the user's repository, which your workspace does not have (it is a copy without .git). Use it to find out when and why code changed, such as the commit that introduced a regression, and what the user had changed before you started. It only reads: nothing in the repository changes. query is one of: status (the baseline commit your copy was made from, the user's changes not committed that your copy started with, and your own changes since); log (commits, newest first, with the files each changed; narrow it with rev, path and search); show (one commit's message and patch); diff (from a commit, by default the baseline, to another commit given as to, or without to to your files as they are now); blame (who last changed each line of a file as of a commit, by default the baseline). HEAD means the baseline, even when the user's HEAD has moved since your copy was made. Paths are relative to your workspace, and history outside it is not shown. An answer is cut at about 40 KB: narrow it with path, limit or lines.","input_schema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"end_line":{"description":"blame: the last line.","type":"integer"},"from":{"description":"diff: the commit to compare from. Default the baseline.","type":"string"},"limit":{"description":"log: most commits. Default 20, at most 100.","type":"integer"},"path":{"description":"A file or directory, relative to your workspace. blame needs a file.","type":"string"},"query":{"enum":["status","log","show","diff","blame"],"type":"string"},"rev":{"description":"A commit: an id, a branch, a tag or HEAD~2. log also takes a range A..B, and starts from the baseline without one; show needs it.","type":"string"},"search":{"description":"log: only commits that added or removed this exact text.","type":"string"},"start_line":{"description":"blame: the first line, from 1.","type":"integer"},"to":{"description":"diff: the commit to compare to. Without it, your files as they are now.","type":"string"}},"required":["query"],"type":"object"},"name":"git","strict":true}
